clips.title: The story
paras: Dark Cleric Duesten sends you from Deathknell to Brill in In Favor of Darkness. There, you continue your training with Dark Cleric Beryl and study the Holy Light and Shadow.

Dark Cleric Duesten teaches that the Forsaken were forged in corruption and discarded like carrion. Their survival demands that they understand both Light and Shadow without sentimentality. In Tirisfal Glades, you leave Deathknell's graveyard and face the wider world beyond its walls.

You follow the road northeast from Deathknell, cross a wooden covered bridge, and reach the ruined hamlet of Brill. Dark Cleric Beryl waits in the upper quarters of the local inn to test your resolve. He values ambition and cold practicality over blind devotion, and expects a Forsaken priest to wield divine power as a weapon and a tool, not a moral crutch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There are many lessons that the Forsaken have learned through experience—things that some races can only begin to fathom. And although our path lies in darkness, you will find that a great many things rely on both the light and the dark. Your lessons shall teach you to use both... And with discretion. But heed my words: never forget we were forged in corruption and left to rot like so much carrion. The Darkness is our home.
Seek out Dark Cleric Beryl in Brill when you're ready to learn more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Finally, you've arrived. Your faith alone will not allow you to pass the trials before you, young one. A sense of urgency and some ambition will help too.
